tre.y: You get pulled into your friends' plans easily and find it hard to say no to people on your level.
tre.tranh: pooling money before agreeing who does what, taking the blame for the whole group
tre.lam: for every shared task, write down each person's part before you start

lon.y: People on your level can become quiet rivals: chasing the same spot, the same client, the same money.
lon.tranh: going into business with someone only because you feel obliged, arguing in public with colleagues at your level
lon.lam: keep one sum of your own out of any shared pot, and settle questions of who gets what on paper

thuan.y: Friends who share your goals have your back; group work comes together more easily.
thuan.lam: invite one trusted friend into a small project, and split the parts clearly from day one

can.nhan: keep your money from being split

tre.y: Money slips out through friends: treating people, lending, being talked into big nights out.
tre.tranh: lending to friends when you are short yourself, investing because someone online told you to
tre.lam: set a monthly limit for spending on friends, and keep a polite reason ready for saying no

lon.y: Someone may compete with you or want a share of money you thought was already safe.
lon.tranh: signing as guarantor for someone else, putting all your capital into one deal just to beat a rival
lon.lam: spread your money across a few places, and get both signatures on every money agreement

thuan.y: You have the nerve and people on your side; where there is competition, you can win your share.
thuan.lam: take on a task that needs drive, but decide in advance the most you are willing to lose

can.nhan: do not let easy turn into lazy

tre.y: You drift easily into fun, late nights, and doing just enough work.
tre.tranh: spending a lot on eating and going out, dropping a course you already paid for
tre.lam: keep one hour a day for building your skills, and be asleep before midnight

lon.y: Life slows down and new things feel like a chore; your children or meals at home take up a lot of your attention.
lon.tranh: eating irregularly around parties, doing all your child's tasks instead of letting them try
lon.lam: keep regular mealtimes, and give your child one clear household job each week

thuan.y: People pay for your skills; work done with your own hands pays off.
thuan.lam: finish one complete piece of work and hand it to someone to try out

can.nhan: mind your words with those above you

tre.y: You may speak too bluntly, argue with seniors, and lose a chance because of it.
tre.tranh: posting angry messages about your workplace, quitting right after one piece of criticism
tre.lam: write down what you want to say, wait one night, then send it

lon.y: Paperwork, contracts and things you said can be picked apart; things with your boss feel tenser.
lon.tranh: making important promises only by word of mouth, signing legal papers before someone who knows them has read them
lon.lam: put every agreement in writing and keep a copy

thuan.nhan: good for new ideas and speaking up
thuan.y: Your new ideas get heard; persuading, presenting and writing go well.
thuan.lam: present an idea you have been holding for a long time to someone who can decide

Thiên Tài.mang: business money, income outside your salary

tre.y: Fast-money chances show up often, but most are bait or more than you can handle.
tre.tranh: borrowing to invest, joining schemes that promise high returns, leaving your main job for short-term deals
tre.lam: try new opportunities only with spare money, and set your stop point in advance

lon.y: Business money moves in and out in large amounts; one rushed decision can take a whole year to repair.
lon.tranh: expanding a business on borrowed money, taking investment from someone you just met
lon.lam: plan your cash flow by quarter, and ask an outsider's view before any large sum

thuan.nhan: good for adding a new income stream
thuan.y: Income comes from outside your main work, and good business contacts are easier to meet.
thuan.lam: take on one extra job that suits you, and put the profit into a long-term fund

can.nhan: hold on tight to your steady income

tre.y: Income is steady, but household spending or shared money with a partner can turn into a problem.
tre.tranh: buying something big on a long instalment plan, pooling money with a partner before talking it through
tre.lam: make a monthly spending sheet, and keep your own account separate from the shared one

lon.y: Savings get drawn down for family matters, your spouse's needs or relatives.
lon.tranh: emptying your savings for something that is not urgent, lending to relatives with no date for repayment
lon.lam: keep one savings pot you never touch, and talk to your family before every large expense

thuan.y: Money comes in steadily and stays; a good time for long-range things like a home, education or insurance.
thuan.lam: raise your monthly savings and finish one savings goal you already set

tre.y: Urgent tasks, demanding people and pressure pile up; you may get heated and act rashly.
tre.tranh: taking on many urgent jobs at once, confronting people with more power than you head-on
tre.lam: break urgent work into small pieces, and ask someone experienced to show you the way

lon.y: Responsibility weighs heavy; a big task may arrive before you are ready.
lon.tranh: carrying everything alone, making big decisions while tired
lon.lam: hand some work to people you trust, protect your sleep, and keep up regular health check-ups

thuan.nhan: good for taking on hard work
thuan.y: Hard work arrives just when you are strong enough; get through it and you earn your place.
thuan.lam: take on a hard task others avoid, and plan it week by week

tre.y: Your workplace has many rules, and you may feel boxed in and judged harshly.
tre.tranh: breaking rules to go faster, changing jobs after a single warning
tre.lam: ask for the evaluation criteria at the start of the year and deliver each small task on time

lon.y: Your position draws scrutiny; permits, procedures and regulations tend to be slow.
lon.tranh: cutting corners on procedures, starting big work before the permits are done
lon.lam: complete the paperwork before you begin, and keep clear records of your work

thuan.nhan: good for moving up in your field
thuan.y: You are more likely to be recognised, given a clearer role, or promoted.
thuan.lam: take on more responsibility in your own field and ask for your position to be reviewed

can.nhan: do not keep your thoughts to yourself

tre.y: You may withdraw, think more than you act, and drop unusual subjects halfway.
tre.tranh: signing up for many courses at once, cutting yourself off when something upsets you
tre.lam: choose one subject and see it through, and meet a close friend every week

lon.y: You worry ahead, doubt things and find it hard to trust; work slows because you hesitate.
lon.tranh: holding a worry inside for too long, believing gossip instead of checking
lon.lam: write the worry down with one thing you can do right away, and talk to someone you trust

thuan.y: Your mind is clear, new things sink in fast, and you find your own way of doing things.
thuan.lam: study a specialised subject in depth, or get a certificate you have wanted for a long time

Chính Ấn.mang: paperwork, home, people who protect you

can.nhan: paperwork and home matters go slow

tre.y: You may lean on family and be slow to decide for yourself; school paperwork can get stuck.
tre.tranh: letting others decide your big matters, handing in applications at the last minute
tre.lam: read and submit your own papers, at least one week before the deadline

lon.y: Your home, property papers or the health of older relatives need a lot of your care.
lon.tranh: buying or selling property before the papers are clear, leaving your parents' matters until the last minute
lon.lam: go over your property papers and your parents' check-up schedule at the start of the year

thuan.nhan: good for paperwork and home matters
thuan.y: Someone has your back; paperwork, qualifications and home matters go smoothly.
thuan.lam: finish a home or qualification process that has been left half done

can.nhan: your child should take it slow

Tỷ Kiếp.nhan: your child may clash with peers
Tỷ Kiếp.y: Your child may compete with classmates or with brothers and sisters at home.
Tỷ Kiếp.tranh: comparing your child with their siblings, settling a quarrel before hearing both sides
Tỷ Kiếp.lam: give each child their own task and praise each one separately; hear your child out before you advise

Ấn.nhan: your child needs to do things themselves
Ấn.y: Your child may rely on adults and avoid doing homework or looking after their own things.
Ấn.tranh: doing your child's homework, tidying all their things for them
Ấn.lam: let your child pack their own bag and set their own study time; adults only check at the weekend

Thực Thương.nhan: your child may speak bluntly or talk back
Thực Thương.y: Your child may talk back to teachers or parents, or say things that hurt a friend.
Thực Thương.tranh: punishing your child in front of others, making them be quiet without explaining why
Thực Thương.lam: teach your child one phrase to use instead of talking back, and praise them when they speak gently

Tài.nhan: your child learns to look after things and money
Tài.mang: your child's belongings and pocket money
Tài.y: Your child may lose things, spend pocket money fast, or lend to friends who do not pay back.
Tài.tranh: replacing things straight away every time they are lost, giving money without asking what it is for
Tài.lam: give your child a fixed amount each week and keep a spending notebook together

Quan Sát.nhan: your child is under pressure and needs support
Quan Sát.y: Your child may feel the pressure of exams and rules, and fear letting adults down.
Quan Sát.tranh: adding more extra classes, scolding your child over one low mark
Quan Sát.lam: protect your child's sleep, and ask what worries them most at school

thuan.nhan: a good year for your child

Tỷ Kiếp.nhan: a year your child makes good friends
Tỷ Kiếp.y: Your child is likely to make good close friends and learn a lot from group work.
Tỷ Kiếp.lam: let your child join a club or team they like

Ấn.nhan: a year your child takes in their studies
Ấn.y: Your child takes in more of their studies and gets more attention from teachers.
Ấn.lam: let your child take an extra class in the subject they ask about most

Thực Thương.nhan: a year your child is handy and full of ideas
Thực Thương.y: Your child has many ideas and may make things that surprise the adults.
Thực Thương.lam: let your child try drawing, music or crafts, and display what they make

Tài.nhan: good for teaching your child about money
Tài.y: Your child understands money more easily and learns to save.
Tài.lam: pick one thing your child wants to buy and save up for it together

Quan Sát.nhan: a year your child can take on a role
Quan Sát.y: Your child is more likely to be trusted with tasks and to carry them through.
Quan Sát.lam: let your child take a role in class or a fixed job at home

nam_tuoi.y: Folk custom says that in your zodiac year you should keep to your routines and not pile many big things into the same year.
nam_tuoi.tranh: starting many big things at once
nam_tuoi.lam: pick the one biggest task and do it carefully, and have a routine health check-up early in the year

xung_tuoi.nhan: a year that clashes with your zodiac sign
xung_tuoi.y: Folk custom sees a year that clashes with your zodiac sign as a year of change: moving, changing jobs, travelling far.
xung_tuoi.tranh: changing many things at the same time
xung_tuoi.lam: change one thing at a time, and keep one familiar routine to lean on

va_tuoi.nhan: a year that rubs against your zodiac sign
va_tuoi.y: Folk custom sees this as a year of small run-ins with the people around you.

tam_tai.y: By custom, during the three Tam Tai years in a row, big plans deserve more careful thought.
tam_tai.tranh: rushing to start building, marry or open a shop just because you found a good date, without being ready
tam_tai.lam: make a money plan covering all three years, and talk big plans through with your family

xung_ngay.nhan: your home and closest people may be unsettled
xung_ngay.y: Your home or the person closest to you (spouse, partner) may go through changes.
xung_ngay.tranh: moving house or deciding big things as a couple in a hurry
xung_ngay.lam: talk every change of home through with your family first, and keep the habit of having dinner together

hinh_ngay.nhan: small clashes with people close to you
hinh_ngay.y: Small clashes with people close to you may keep repeating.

than.manh: Your own strength: strong, stands on its own
than.yeu: Your own strength: needs more support

nhom.Tỷ Kiếp: standing on your own, people on your level
nhom.Tài: money, results you can hold on to

Giáp.chan_dung: You are like a tall tree: upright, reaching higher, and often sheltering others. You do your best work when you have a long-term goal to hold on to.
Giáp.cau_tu_soi: Where are you trying to stand straight when you would do better to bend a little?

manh.manh: You can stand on your own and rarely need a push to get going.
manh.de_vap: Once you decide, you find it hard to take advice, stiff as a tree that will not bend.
manh.loi_khuyen: Pick one person you trust to challenge your thinking before you settle anything big.

yeu.manh: You know how to lean on good teachers and good teams to grow, and you do not mind starting over.
yeu.de_vap: When pressure piles up, you can lose direction and drop long plans halfway.
yeu.loi_khuyen: Break big goals into three-month stages, and find a mentor for the first stage.

can_bang.manh: You have drive and also know when to step back, so you rarely break down halfway.
can_bang.de_vap: You often take on caring for others and forget your own share.
can_bang.loi_khuyen: Keep a fixed block of time each week for your own things.

Ất.hinh_tuong: a climbing vine, grass and flowers
Ất.chan_dung: You are like a climbing vine, or grass and flowers: soft but tough, holding on to something solid so you can spread out. You are good at finding your way and good with people.
Ất.cau_tu_soi: Who or what are you holding on to, and is that support still solid?

manh.manh: You are persistent; pushed back, you find another way forward.
manh.de_vap: You may try to please several sides at once and tangle up your own work.
manh.loi_khuyen: Say "let me think about it" instead of saying yes straight away.

yeu.manh: You are good at finding help and know how to ask without making anyone uncomfortable.
yeu.de_vap: Without someone to lean on, you may hesitate and wait for others to decide for you.
yeu.loi_khuyen: Practise making small daily decisions yourself to get used to being in charge.

can_bang.manh: You are gentle but principled, so many people trust you.
can_bang.de_vap: You tend to keep discomfort inside until it wears you out.
can_bang.loi_khuyen: Say what you do not like early, while it is still small.

Bính.chan_dung: You are like the sun: bright, warm, happy to be seen, and good at drawing people into shared work. Wherever you are, the mood lifts.
Bính.cau_tu_soi: Who are you keeping warm, and are you keeping some of that warmth for yourself?

manh.manh: You are enthusiastic and willing to stand up in front of a crowd.
manh.de_vap: You may talk loud and move fast, then run out of breath halfway.
manh.loi_khuyen: Take on fewer tasks but see them through before you take on more.

yeu.manh: You are warm, a good listener, and you understand how others feel.
yeu.de_vap: You tire when you have to stay cheerful and lively nonstop without rest.
yeu.loi_khuyen: Put quiet days after busy social stretches.

can_bang.manh: You can spread enthusiasm and still know when to stop.
can_bang.de_vap: You feel hurt when nobody mentions the effort you put in.
can_bang.loi_khuyen: Note down what you achieved each month yourself, instead of waiting for praise.

Đinh.chan_dung: You are like a lamp: not dazzling, but lighting up what is close by. You are perceptive, notice details, and long remember what others did for you.
Đinh.cau_tu_soi: What are you worrying about alone that you could share with someone you trust?

manh.manh: You focus well; whatever you do, you do thoroughly.
manh.de_vap: You keep thoughts to yourself, and thinking too much turns into worry.
manh.loi_khuyen: Write down what worries you, break it into pieces and deal with them one by one.

yeu.manh: You are sensitive to how others feel and know how to comfort them.
yeu.de_vap: You can be swayed by praise and criticism around you.
yeu.loi_khuyen: Choose two or three people you trust to ask for advice, and listen less to the crowd.

can_bang.manh: You are thoughtful and make people feel cared for.
can_bang.de_vap: You avoid conflict, so sometimes you stay silent too long.
can_bang.loi_khuyen: State what you want in one short sentence instead of waiting for others to guess.

Mậu.chan_dung: You are like a mountain: steady, slow to change, the place people come to when they need support. You keep your word and like things in order.
Mậu.cau_tu_soi: What are you keeping the same only out of habit, not because it is still right?

manh.manh: You can handle heavy work, and the more urgent it is, the calmer you get.
manh.de_vap: You find it hard to change your mind and may stick to old ways after they stop working.
manh.loi_khuyen: Try one new way of doing something each quarter, even on a small task.

yeu.manh: You are careful and rarely promise what you cannot do.
yeu.de_vap: You may hesitate to start, waiting until you are sure, and miss the chance.
yeu.loi_khuyen: Set a deadline for weighing things up; past it, try the idea on a small scale.

can_bang.manh: You are reliable, steady in your work, rarely up and down.
can_bang.de_vap: You often carry other people's work because you find it hard to refuse.
can_bang.loi_khuyen: Practise saying no to one task outside your own share each week.

Kỷ.chan_dung: You are like garden soil: able to nourish many things, patient and practical. You are good at caring, organising, and turning small things into useful ones.
Kỷ.cau_tu_soi: How many people are you looking after, and who is looking after you?

manh.manh: You are steady, plan ahead, and know how to save bit by bit.
manh.de_vap: You take on too much and want to handle everything yourself.
manh.loi_khuyen: Hand off some tasks and accept that others will do them their own way.

yeu.manh: You adapt easily and find your place wherever you are.
yeu.de_vap: You may let others take your share and avoid asking for what you are owed.
yeu.loi_khuyen: Write down the agreement about effort and money from the very start.

can_bang.manh: You are thorough and remember what the whole family or team needs.
can_bang.de_vap: You often worry in advance about things that have not happened.
can_bang.loi_khuyen: Separate what needs handling today from what you only need to note down for later.

Canh.chan_dung: You are like a steel bar: straight, strong, and you do what you say. You like things clear and dislike beating around the bush.
Canh.cau_tu_soi: The last time you spoke bluntly, what did the other person actually hear?

manh.manh: You decide fast and take responsibility for your decisions.
manh.de_vap: You can be so blunt that you hurt people.
manh.loi_khuyen: Pause three seconds before giving feedback and ask yourself what the other person needs to hear.

yeu.manh: You have clear principles and know what you will not accept.
yeu.de_vap: When pushed, you may harden and then let go of both the task and the people.
yeu.loi_khuyen: Choose a place with clear leadership to build more staying power.

can_bang.manh: You are direct but still know how to say things so others can hear them.
can_bang.de_vap: You tend to expect a lot from the people close to you.
can_bang.loi_khuyen: Praise what others did well before saying what needs fixing.

Tân.chan_dung: You are like a polished piece of jewellery: refined, clean, with your own taste. You care about how things look and about doing them properly.
Tân.cau_tu_soi: Where are you demanding perfection when good enough would do?

manh.manh: You have an eye for beauty and high standards in your work.
manh.de_vap: You get annoyed by anything less than perfect, including in yourself.
manh.loi_khuyen: Set a good-enough bar for everyday tasks and keep the high bar for what matters.

yeu.manh: You are sensitive and sharp, and notice what others miss.
yeu.de_vap: You feel hurt by criticism and lose the will to keep going.
yeu.loi_khuyen: Separate criticism of the work from criticism of you as a person.

can_bang.manh: You are tactful and know how to be discreet with people.
can_bang.de_vap: You avoid showing weak spots, so you rarely ask for help.
can_bang.loi_khuyen: Ask for help early with things you are not yet good at.

Nhâm.chan_dung: You are like a great river: always flowing, full of ideas, fond of going far and trying new things. You pick things up fast and cope well with change.
Nhâm.cau_tu_soi: What have you opened that you have not yet closed?

manh.manh: You have plenty of energy, and when blocked you find another route right away.
manh.de_vap: You may drift, opening many things and struggling to close them.
manh.loi_khuyen: Choose one main task for each stage and fully close the old one before opening a new one.

yeu.manh: You are flexible, read people quickly and fit into new places easily.
yeu.de_vap: You get swept up in other people's business and spend energy where it does not belong.
yeu.loi_khuyen: Keep a few fixed habits in your day as banks for your river.

can_bang.manh: You are clever, see far ahead and still stay on top of the task at hand.
can_bang.de_vap: You keep your plans to yourself, so people close to you struggle to keep up.
can_bang.loi_khuyen: Share your plans early with the people working with you so they can prepare.

Quý.chan_dung: You are like an underground spring, or a light rain: quiet but soaking in deep. You are perceptive, imaginative, and understand people through what they leave unsaid.
Quý.cau_tu_soi: What are you feeling that you have not yet said out loud?

manh.manh: You are patient and work quietly toward lasting results.
manh.de_vap: You sink into your own thoughts and share little.
manh.loi_khuyen: Set a weekly chat with someone close to say what is on your mind.

yeu.manh: You are sensitive and full of compassion.
yeu.de_vap: You tire from carrying other people's feelings.
yeu.loi_khuyen: Keep a time when your phone is off and you are alone with yourself.

can_bang.manh: You are deep yet gentle, good at untangling delicate matters.
can_bang.de_vap: You often doubt your ability even after doing well.
can_bang.loi_khuyen: Keep a list of things you have achieved to look at when you lose heart.

Tỷ Kiên.y: You are independent, like doing things your own way and want to be treated as an equal.
Tỷ Kiên.de_vap: You avoid asking for help and taking orders, and may end up carrying the work alone.
Tỷ Kiên.loi_khuyen: Choose work where you can decide for yourself, and learn to ask the right person for help.

Kiếp Tài.y: You dare to compete and move fast when you see a chance.
Kiếp Tài.de_vap: You may take risks, spend on impulse and compare yourself with people at your level.
Kiếp Tài.loi_khuyen: Set a maximum amount of money for each quick decision.

Thực Thần.y: You are easy-going, know how to enjoy life, and make things people can use, eat or look at.
Thực Thần.de_vap: You may be satisfied too soon and avoid hard work that drags on.
Thực Thần.loi_khuyen: Set one goal a little beyond your reach each year so you do not slow down.

Thương Quan.y: You are creative, speak well and spot what does not make sense very quickly.
Thương Quan.de_vap: You criticise easily and may break rules you think are pointless.
Thương Quan.loi_khuyen: Every time you point out a fault, offer a way to fix it.

Thiên Tài.y: You are quick to see opportunities, generous, and used to a wide circle of contacts.
Thiên Tài.de_vap: You may spend freely and use the next income to cover the last expense.
Thiên Tài.loi_khuyen: Open a separate account for money that must not be touched.

Chính Tài.y: You are practical, hard-working, and value trust and stability.
Chính Tài.de_vap: You may be too tight with money and miss things worth investing in.
Chính Tài.loi_khuyen: Set aside a small fixed share for learning or new experiences.

Thất Sát.y: You are bold, handle pressure well, and the harder it gets the more you want to win.
Thất Sát.de_vap: You can be quick-tempered and push yourself and others too hard.
Thất Sát.loi_khuyen: Have a regular way to burn off energy, like running or badminton.

Chính Quan.y: You are proper, follow the rules, and older people trust you with tasks.
Chính Quan.de_vap: You worry about what others think of you and avoid doing things differently from the crowd.
Chính Quan.loi_khuyen: Ask yourself what you want before asking what others expect of you.

Thiên Ấn.y: You have your own way of thinking, like the new and unusual, and like digging deep into a narrow field.
Thiên Ấn.de_vap: You may withdraw, be suspicious, and drop things once the interest fades.
Thiên Ấn.loi_khuyen: Tie your personal interests to a concrete piece of work so you have something to finish.

Chính Ấn.y: You love learning, are kind, and think of others.
Chính Ấn.de_vap: You tend to wait for instructions and hesitate to take the lead.
Chính Ấn.loi_khuyen: Each year, take on one task you have to own from start to finish.

chinh_quan.ten: someone who keeps to the rules
chinh_quan.y: Your birth month gives you a neat, proper manner, a sense of hierarchy, and a fit for well-ordered places.
chinh_quan.de_vap: You tire quickly in messy places where nobody takes responsibility.
chinh_quan.loi_khuyen: When you join a new group, ask right away who decides what.
chinh_quan.nghe: Suits work in organisations with a clear hierarchy: administration, banking, education, operations management.

that_sat.ten: someone who takes on hard work
that_sat.y: Your birth month gives you the strength to handle pressure and the spirit to charge ahead when things are urgent.
that_sat.de_vap: You may take on more than you can carry and get impatient with people slower than you.
that_sat.loi_khuyen: Pick the battles worth fighting, and leave small things for others.
that_sat.nghe: Suits work with challenges and competition: field engineering, opening new markets, security, sport, incident response.

chinh_tai.y: Your birth month gives you a practical mind, a good hand with money, and a habit of keeping promises.
chinh_tai.de_vap: You may be too cautious and let chances slip by.
chinh_tai.loi_khuyen: Set aside a small sum to try new chances, and keep the rest as before.
chinh_tai.nghe: Suits management, accounting, finance, trading essential goods, supply chain operations.

thien_tai.y: Your birth month gives you an eye for opportunity and a talent for networking and moving money around.
thien_tai.de_vap: You may chase many things at once; money comes in fast and goes out just as fast.
thien_tai.loi_khuyen: Choose at most two opportunities a year and follow them through.
thien_tai.nghe: Suits business, sales, brokerage, disciplined investing, work with outside partners.

chinh_an.ten: someone who loves learning and gets support
chinh_an.y: Your birth month gives you a love of knowledge, and people ahead of you often help you.
chinh_an.de_vap: You may get used to being looked after and be slow to step up.
chinh_an.loi_khuyen: Take on one hard task yourself without asking anyone first.
chinh_an.nghe: Suits education, research, medicine and pharmacy, law, writing, work that needs qualifications and a good name.

thien_an.ten: someone with an original way of thinking
thien_an.y: Your birth month gives you good intuition and interest in fields few people touch.
thien_an.de_vap: You get bored by repetitive work and may drop it before it is done.
thien_an.loi_khuyen: Set a clear finish point for each personal project you are following.
thien_an.nghe: Suits specialist work, unusual technical fields, psychology, design, technology, independent research.

thuc_than.ten: someone talented who likes an easy pace
thuc_than.y: Your birth month gives you skilful hands, a way with words, and a knack for enjoying life.
thuc_than.de_vap: You may avoid pressure and stay too long in work that is well within your comfort zone.
thuc_than.loi_khuyen: Take on one task with a clear deadline each quarter to keep your rhythm.
thuc_than.nghe: Suits food, the arts, teaching children, services, digital content, handmade products.

thuong_quan.ten: someone creative who likes doing things differently
thuong_quan.y: Your birth month gives you a sharp mind, a gift for speaking and presenting, and a liking for doing things differently.
thuong_quan.de_vap: You may clash with bosses and with people who enforce the rules.
thuong_quan.loi_khuyen: Choose places that judge you by results rather than by seniority.
thuong_quan.nghe: Suits content creation, media, litigation, design, start-ups, the performing arts.

kien_loc.ten: someone independent from an early age
kien_loc.y: Your birth month gives you self-reliance: whatever you want, you usually make it happen yourself.
kien_loc.de_vap: You may carry everything alone and rarely rely on systems or other people.
kien_loc.loi_khuyen: Build a small trusted team instead of doing everything yourself.
kien_loc.nghe: Suits self-directed work, independent professions, managing your own area, a small business you run.

duong_nhan.y: Your birth month gives you strong drive, quick decisions and the nerve to face opposition.
duong_nhan.de_vap: You may be hasty and act more forcefully than needed.
duong_nhan.loi_khuyen: Look for a place with clear discipline so that strength has the right outlet.
duong_nhan.nghe: Suits work that needs decisiveness and discipline: the military, police, surgery, heavy engineering, sport.

nguyet_kiep.y: Your birth month gives you a spirit that refuses to lose; the more rivals, the harder you try.
nguyet_kiep.de_vap: You may fight for your share and spend money to come out ahead of others.
nguyet_kiep.loi_khuyen: Make last year's you the rival, not the person next to you.
nguyet_kiep.nghe: Suits sales with targets, sport, start-ups, places with clear competition.

Kim.thua: Too much Metal can make you rigid, judging right and wrong sharply even in matters of the heart.
Kim.thua_loi_khuyen: Practise adding one caring question before each comment you make.
Kim.thieu: With little Metal, you may lack decisiveness, find it hard to say no and hard to cut what is not needed.
Kim.thieu_loi_khuyen: Make a to-do list each morning and firmly cross out the things you will not do.
Kim.nghe: finance, engineering, machinery, law, quality control
Kim.thoi_quen: tidying your desk, making to-do lists, deep breathing in the morning
Kim.nhip_thua: You tend to tense up and hold stress in your body; your neck and shoulders tire easily.
Kim.nhip_thieu: You run short of breath during long stretches of work.
Kim.loi_khuyen_sk: Practise breathing exercises, walk in fresh air, and keep your throat warm when the seasons change.
Kim.tieu_de_thua: Lots of Metal: can be rigid
Kim.tieu_de_thieu: Little Metal: hard to be decisive

Mộc.thua: Too much Wood can make you take on too many plans and cling to your own ideas.
Mộc.thua_loi_khuyen: Choose three main plans for each year and put the rest on a waiting list.
Mộc.thieu: With little Wood, you may hesitate to start, avoid change and lack long-range plans.
Mộc.thieu_loi_khuyen: Write a one-year plan on a single page and review it every month.
Mộc.nghe: education, publishing, plants and farming, design, caring for people
Mộc.thoi_quen: looking after a potted plant, walking in the park, reading a few pages every evening
Mộc.nhip_thua: You get irritable when blocked and often stay up late to get things finished.
Mộc.nhip_thieu: You can feel stiff from too little stretching.
Mộc.loi_khuyen_sk: Be asleep before 23h, stretch every day, and rest your eyes after each hour of screen time.
Mộc.tieu_de_thua: Lots of Wood: takes on too much

Thủy.ten: the mind, flexibility, the ability to adapt
Thủy.thua: Too much Water can make you overthink, worry ahead and feel your moods swing.
Thủy.thua_loi_khuyen: Set a time to stop thinking: write the worry on paper and leave it until morning.
Thủy.thieu: With little Water, you may be rigid and slow to soften when things change.
Thủy.thieu_loi_khuyen: Practise coming up with two options for each task instead of one.
Thủy.nghe: transport, travel, media, trade, information technology
Thủy.thoi_quen: drinking enough water, sleeping enough, keeping quiet time, swimming
Thủy.nhip_thua: You often lose sleep because your thoughts keep going round in circles.
Thủy.nhip_thieu: You forget to drink water when you are busy.
Thủy.loi_khuyen_sk: Drink enough water, keep your back and feet warm, and sleep enough at a fixed time.

Hỏa.thua: Too much Fire can make you hasty, speaking faster than you think and unable to sit still.
Hỏa.thua_loi_khuyen: Practise sitting still for a few minutes before answering anything urgent.
Hỏa.thieu: With little Fire, you may lack enthusiasm and hold back from showing yourself.
Hỏa.thieu_loi_khuyen: Do one thing you enjoy each week and tell someone about it.
Hỏa.nghe: media, entertainment, food, energy, work in front of an audience
Hỏa.thoi_quen: morning sunlight, exercise that makes you sweat, cheerful time with friends
Hỏa.nhip_thua: You tend to stay up late and drink a lot of coffee to keep going.
Hỏa.nhip_thieu: Your hands and feet get cold, and you feel sluggish in the cold season.
Hỏa.loi_khuyen_sk: Keep a steady rhythm of work and rest, cut back on stimulants in the evening, and exercise moderately every day.
Hỏa.tieu_de_thua: Lots of Fire: can be hasty

Thổ.ten: steadiness, trustworthiness, the ability to gather and keep
Thổ.thua: Too much Earth can make you sluggish, slow to change and weighed down by worries.
Thổ.thua_loi_khuyen: Change one small habit each month so you do not get stuck.
Thổ.thieu: With little Earth, you may lack something to lean on, and plans tend to break off.
Thổ.thieu_loi_khuyen: Keep a fixed daily routine as the frame for everything else.
Thổ.nghe: real estate, construction, agriculture, warehouse management, administration, insurance
Thổ.thoi_quen: eating at regular times, gardening, walking barefoot on grass
Thổ.nhip_thua: You tend to eat irregularly when stressed.
Thổ.nhip_thieu: You skip meals and eat in a rush when busy.
Thổ.loi_khuyen_sk: Eat on time, chew slowly, cut back on late-night eating, and take a gentle walk after meals.
Thổ.tieu_de_thua: Lots of Earth: sluggish, slow to change
Thổ.tieu_de_thieu: Little Earth: lacks a steady base

Thiên Ất Quý Nhân.tieu_de: Help tends to arrive at the right moment
Thiên Ất Quý Nhân.y: In hard times, you often meet someone who helps at just the right moment: a teacher, a boss, or a friend of a friend.
Thiên Ất Quý Nhân.loi_khuyen: Stay in touch with people who have helped you, and help others when you can.

Văn Xương.y: You pick up reading and writing quickly, and you write and present clearly.
Văn Xương.loi_khuyen: Use your writing strength to record what you know, as a base for teaching or sharing.

Thái Cực Quý Nhân.y: You like to ask why, and often look into the philosophy and meaning behind things.
Thái Cực Quý Nhân.loi_khuyen: Pick one subject to study systematically instead of reading here and there.

Hoa Cái.y: You learn and work best on your own, with a gift for art or reflection.
Hoa Cái.loi_khuyen: Keep a quiet corner just for work that needs focus.

Dịch Mã.tieu_de: Suited to travel and moving around
Dịch Mã.y: You suit travel, changing places, and work that involves moving around or living in several places.
Dịch Mã.loi_khuyen: Choose work that lets you get around instead of sitting in one place too long.

Tướng Tinh.tieu_de: Natural authority when leading a group
Tướng Tinh.y: When you step up to lead a group, you have authority and others follow you easily.
Tướng Tinh.loi_khuyen: Take a lead role on small tasks first to practise leading people.

Đào Hoa.y: You have a natural charm and people notice you when you talk with them.
Đào Hoa.loi_khuyen: Keep a sense of measure and be clear about your boundaries once you have a partner.

Hồng Diễm.y: You are graceful and full of feeling in matters of love.
Hồng Diễm.loi_khuyen: Give a relationship time for you to understand each other instead of deciding on first feelings.

Vong Thần.tieu_de: Can get caught up in gossip
Vong Thần.y: You can get pulled into gossip, or overthink the angles in your relationships.
Vong Thần.loi_khuyen: Avoid talking about people who are not there, and speak directly when there is a misunderstanding.

Kiếp Sát.tieu_de: Can lose out to sudden events
Kiếp Sát.y: You may lose money or energy to sudden events caused by other people.
Kiếp Sát.loi_khuyen: Sign clear paperwork and keep an emergency fund.

Khôi Cương.y: You are strong-willed and outspoken, and once you decide you rarely change your mind.
Khôi Cương.loi_khuyen: Choose softer words when talking with family.

Dương Nhận.tieu_de: Reacts strongly when your pride is hurt
Dương Nhận.y: When your pride is hurt, you can react strongly and fast.
Dương Nhận.loi_khuyen: Wait one night before answering a message that annoys you.

Cô Thần.tieu_de: Used to looking after yourself, sometimes lonely
Cô Thần.y: You are used to looking after yourself, and sometimes feel alone even among family.
Cô Thần.loi_khuyen: Take the lead in setting up small, regular get-togethers with family.

Quả Tú.y: You are independent, used to managing on your own, and sometimes slow to open up.
Quả Tú.loi_khuyen: Tell the people close to you what is going on with you, even the small things.

Lộc Thần.y: You have a base of self-reliance: even from a small start, you can look after yourself.
Lộc Thần.loi_khuyen: Invest in your skills; they are your most lasting source of income.

Kim Dư.y: You often get a helping hand in your relationships, especially from people who are well off.
Kim Dư.loi_khuyen: Value that help and return it so the relationship lasts.

Thiên Đức.tieu_de: Hard times usually have a way out
Thiên Đức.y: Hard situations usually have a way out for you, especially when you treat the people around you kindly.
Thiên Đức.loi_khuyen: Keep a habit of small, regular good deeds.

Nguyệt Đức.tieu_de: Hard times usually have a way out
Nguyệt Đức.y: Hard situations usually have a way out for you, especially when you treat the people around you kindly.
Nguyệt Đức.loi_khuyen: Keep a habit of small, regular good deeds.

quan_an.tieu_de: Rising through trust and a will to learn
quan_an.y: You move up because people trust you with work and because you keep learning to deserve your role. Qualifications, certificates and mentors are your levers.
quan_an.loi_khuyen: Choose a place with a clear path to promotion, and invest in a certificate that counts in your field.

tai_sinh_quan.tieu_de: Concrete results open the way to a role
tai_sinh_quan.y: The money-making results you deliver often open the way to a higher position. People respect you because you bring in real work.
tai_sinh_quan.loi_khuyen: Keep a record of your results in numbers to use when you talk about promotion or a raise.

quan_ro.tieu_de: Suited to places with clear rules and roles
quan_ro.y: You suit places with rules, ranks and clear roles. Given a responsibility, you see it through.
quan_ro.loi_khuyen: Choose an organisation with clear processes, and tell your manager early what you want to achieve.

quan_nang.y: Work pressure and responsibility can weigh more than you can carry right now. You often take on extra because you find it hard to say no to those above you.
quan_nang.loi_khuyen: Ask about the scope of a task before you accept it, and ask for more people or time when you are overloaded.

thuong_kien_quan.tieu_de: Prone to friction with your boss
thuong_kien_quan.y: You often find your boss's way of doing things unreasonable and say so directly. You may be right, but the way you say it costs you.
thuong_kien_quan.loi_khuyen: Give feedback in private, in a short written note, with an alternative included.

tu_lam.tieu_de: Suited to earning from your own skills
tu_lam.y: You are better suited to earning from your own skills or expertise, or working for yourself, than to climbing the ladder in a big organisation.
tu_lam.loi_khuyen: Build a product or service under your own name, however small, and grow it step by step.

thieu_khung.tieu_de: Without someone setting goals, you drift
thieu_khung.y: When nobody sets goals for you, you drift with whatever is in front of you and change direction many times.
thieu_khung.loi_khuyen: Set your own quarterly goals and find someone in your field to report progress to.

sat_lo.tieu_de: Willing to take on hard, urgent work
sat_lo.y: You dare to take on hard, urgent work that others avoid. Pressure makes you sharper.
sat_lo.loi_khuyen: Take roles with a clear challenge, a deadline, and the authority to decide.

chinh_quan_lo.tieu_de: Careful and true to your word
chinh_quan_lo.y: You work carefully, keep your word, and people in charge trust you.
chinh_quan_lo.loi_khuyen: Keep the habit of short reports delivered on time: your reputation grows from there.

tai_ganh_duoc.tieu_de: Able to earn and manage money
tai_ganh_duoc.y: You are strong enough to hold on to money: you can earn it and manage it. The more responsibility you take for money, the better you do.
tai_ganh_duoc.loi_khuyen: Set yearly goals for your assets and track them in a simple sheet.

tai_nang_than_yeu.tieu_de: Plenty of money comes, but carrying it is tiring
tai_nang_than_yeu.y: Money and chances to earn come fairly often, but carrying them can wear you out. Juggling many sources at once can leave you drained.
tai_nang_than_yeu.loi_khuyen: Choose a few solid sources of income, and ask someone good with numbers to help manage the rest.

tai_vua.tieu_de: Money comes at a manageable level
tai_vua.y: Money comes to you at a manageable level: enough to take care of things, not so much that it becomes a burden.
tai_vua.loi_khuyen: Keep saving at a steady pace and avoid borrowing to expand too fast.

thuc_sinh_tai.y: You earn best from your own skills, ideas or products you make yourself.
thuc_sinh_tai.loi_khuyen: Price your effort fairly, and do not work for free for too long.

kiep_tai.tieu_de: Money slips out through friends and siblings
kiep_tai.y: Your money easily goes out through friends and siblings: lending, pooling, sharing, or spending to save face.
kiep_tai.loi_khuyen: Only lend what you can accept losing, and put it in writing when you pool money.

tai_vang.tieu_de: Money does not come looking for you
tai_vang.y: Money does not come looking for you on its own; spending drifts with whatever you need right now.
tai_vang.loi_khuyen: Set up an automatic transfer to savings on payday, before you spend.

chinh_tai_lo.tieu_de: Suited to steady income and slow, solid saving
chinh_tai_lo.y: You suit steady income: a salary, long-term contracts, savings that grow slowly but surely.
chinh_tai_lo.loi_khuyen: Save according to a long plan, and turn down get-rich-quick offers.

thien_tai_lo.y: You are quick to spot opportunities; money can come from many places, such as side work, trading or referrals.
thien_tai_lo.loi_khuyen: Keep one sum of your own that you never put into risky investments.

nam.sao_ro.tieu_de: Suited to a practical partner who builds a home with you
nam.sao_ro.y: Partnership has a clear place in your life. You suit someone practical who looks after things and shares the running of the home with you.
nam.sao_ro.loi_khuyen: Talk openly with your partner about money and shared plans early on.

nu.sao_ro.tieu_de: You value someone responsible who keeps their word
nu.sao_ro.y: Partnership has a clear place in your life. You value someone responsible, driven, and true to their word.
nu.sao_ro.loi_khuyen: Watch how the other person keeps small promises before you trust the big ones.

nam.sao_nang.tieu_de: You may carry too much in love
nam.sao_nang.y: In love, you may carry a lot: providing, going along with what the other wants, getting tired without saying so.
nam.sao_nang.loi_khuyen: Be clear about each person's share, and keep rest time for yourself.

nu.sao_nang.tieu_de: You may feel pressure from the other person
nu.sao_nang.y: In love, you may feel pressure from the other person: high expectations, a lot of control.
nu.sao_nang.loi_khuyen: Set boundaries from the start: what you decide alone and what you decide together.

nam.sao_vang.tieu_de: Love rarely turns up on its own
nam.sao_vang.y: Love rarely turns up on its own; you are busy with work and pay little attention to romance.
nam.sao_vang.loi_khuyen: Keep regular time for meeting people instead of waiting for the right occasion to open up.

nu.sao_vang.tieu_de: Used to managing alone, so others hesitate to come close
nu.sao_vang.y: You are used to managing on your own and rarely wait for anyone to protect you, so others sometimes hesitate to come close.
nu.sao_vang.loi_khuyen: Let others help you with a few small things; that opens the door to love.

nu.quan_sat_lan.tieu_de: Torn between two kinds of people
nu.quan_sat_lan.y: You may feel torn between two kinds of people: one steady, one with a strong personality.
nu.quan_sat_lan.loi_khuyen: Write down the three things you need most in a partner and check against them when you have to choose.

nam.tranh.tieu_de: Outsiders tend to get involved in your relationship
nam.tranh.y: Friends and outsiders tend to get involved in the private life of the two of you, sometimes leading to comparison.
nam.tranh.loi_khuyen: Keep the private matters of the two of you between the two of you.

chi_ngay_xung.tieu_de: Your rhythms as a couple may drift apart
chi_ngay_xung.y: Your rhythms as a couple may drift apart: one wants to go, one wants to stay, plans keep changing.
chi_ngay_xung.loi_khuyen: Leave personal space for each of you, and give notice of big changes like moving house or changing jobs.

chi_ngay_hinh.tieu_de: You may make things hard for each other with words
chi_ngay_hinh.y: The two of you often make things hard for each other with words, especially when tired.
chi_ngay_hinh.loi_khuyen: Agree on one rule together: when tempers rise, pause and talk again an hour later.

chi_ngay_hop.tieu_de: Able to build a lasting bond
chi_ngay_hop.y: You bond easily and keep your feelings for a long time. With someone by your side, you are far steadier.
chi_ngay_hop.loi_khuyen: Keep the small habits you share, like dinner together or a call at the end of the day.

an_ro.tieu_de: Support from your mother and older relatives
an_ro.y: Your mother or older relatives are your support; in hard times you still have a place to come back to.
an_ro.loi_khuyen: Make regular time for those who looked after you, even when you are busy.

an_nang.tieu_de: Well looked after, so slow to decide for yourself
an_nang.y: You are looked after a lot, so sometimes you hesitate to decide for yourself or let older relatives decide for you.
an_nang.loi_khuyen: Thank them for their care, then say clearly which things you want to decide yourself.

an_vang.tieu_de: Looking after yourself from early on
an_vang.y: You had to look after yourself early, with less protection than many others.
an_vang.loi_khuyen: Allow yourself to accept help: being independent does not mean doing everything alone.

tai_pha_an.tieu_de: Earning money eats into family time
tai_pha_an.y: Money and work often eat into the time you have for family and for learning.
tai_pha_an.loi_khuyen: Keep one fixed block each week for family, and do no work during it.

nam_thang_xung.y: Your family background has some upheaval: moving homes, leaving home early, or living differently from your parents.
nam_thang_xung.loi_khuyen: Stay in touch with your family in a way that suits you; it does not have to look like everyone else's.

nam_thang_hop.y: Your family has close-knit ways, and you carry many good habits from your parents.
nam_thang_hop.loi_khuyen: Pass those family ways on to the next generation.

anh_em_do.y: Your siblings and close friends are real support when you need it.
anh_em_do.loi_khuyen: Keep your word and share fairly so the bond lasts.

anh_em_tranh.y: Siblings may compare who gets more and who gets less, especially over money and caring for your parents.
anh_em_tranh.loi_khuyen: Agree on how family tasks and money are split, in black and white.

anh_em_it.tieu_de: Close friends take the place of siblings
anh_em_it.y: You rely little on your siblings; close friends usually fill that role.
anh_em_it.loi_khuyen: Keep a few long friendships as if they were family.

con_ro.y: Children have a clear place in your life; they are a big motivation for you to keep trying.
con_ro.loi_khuyen: Tell your children about the times you got through hard things, not just about your successes.

con_vang.y: Having and raising children usually needs you to plan your time and energy ahead.
con_vang.loi_khuyen: Plan early for the years with children, both for work and for money.

con_vang_lon.y: Your children tend to become independent early and rarely ask you for help; the bond stays strong through regular check-ins.
con_vang_lon.loi_khuyen: Set regular times to call your children and grandchildren, rather than waiting for a reason to get in touch.

gio_ngay_xung.tieu_de: Your children may be unlike you
gio_ngay_xung.y: Your children, or young people you guide, may have a different temperament and want to go their own way.
gio_ngay_xung.loi_khuyen: Ask what your child thinks before giving advice, and let them choose for themselves in small things.

gio_ngay_hop.tieu_de: Close to children and young people
gio_ngay_hop.y: You get on well with children and young people; you talk easily and they listen.
gio_ngay_hop.loi_khuyen: Make time to play with your children; that is when they learn the most from you.

an_hoc.tieu_de: Learns deeply, needs to understand the roots
an_hoc.y: You learn in depth and need to understand the roots before you feel ready to act.
an_hoc.loi_khuyen: Choose foundational books and well-structured courses over quick tricks.

thuc_than_hoc.y: You learn by doing: trying, tasting, making it yourself is what makes it stick.
thuc_than_hoc.loi_khuyen: Turn each lesson into a small piece of work, like a dish, a piece of writing or a short video.

thuong_quan_hoc.y: You learn fast, ask challenging questions, and dislike learning by heart.
thuong_quan_hoc.loi_khuyen: Learn through projects with clear results, and teach others to check yourself.

thien_an_hoc.y: You have your own way of thinking and often understand by intuition before you can explain it.
thien_an_hoc.loi_khuyen: Jot down ideas as they come, then check them against the facts.

kieu_doat_thuc.tieu_de: Thinks so carefully that good ideas get dropped
kieu_doat_thuc.y: You think things through so carefully that you often set your own ideas aside before trying them.
kieu_doat_thuc.loi_khuyen: Give each idea a small trial for one week before you judge it.

hoc_mong.y: You learn best through real experience; long stretches of theory wear you down.
hoc_mong.loi_khuyen: Choose short courses with real practice and someone to guide you.

nen_mong.y: You talk and act faster than you learn the basics, so sometimes there are gaps in the foundations.
nen_mong.loi_khuyen: Go back over the basics every time you move up a level.

ban_do.y: Friends and colleagues at your level often back you up when needed; working in a group takes you further.
ban_do.loi_khuyen: Choose a small group with shared goals and meet regularly.

ban_tranh.y: With people at your level, things easily turn into competition: who is better, who gets more.
ban_tranh.loi_khuyen: Work together on big things, and compare yourself only with who you were last year.

ban_it.tieu_de: Used to doing it yourself, rarely asks for help
ban_it.y: You are used to doing things yourself and rarely ask your peers for help.
ban_it.loi_khuyen: Try one small joint project to see what teamwork can do for you.

ban_vua.y: You keep a moderate balance with peers: you have people to work with, and rarely fight anyone for a share.
ban_vua.loi_khuyen: Invite someone a little more skilled than you into shared work so you both grow.

ap_luc_ngoai.tieu_de: Feels pressure from people with power
ap_luc_ngoai.y: You easily feel pressure from people with power: bosses, big clients, older people.
ap_luc_ngoai.loi_khuyen: Put agreements in writing, and ask again when a request is unclear.

Tỷ Kiên.y: You suit a relationship like two equal friends: working together, deciding together.
Tỷ Kiên.loi_khuyen: Split housework and money matters clearly so nobody feels short-changed.

Kiếp Tài.tieu_de: Prone to competing over who is ahead
Kiếp Tài.y: You and your partner may compete over who is right and who comes out ahead.
Kiếp Tài.loi_khuyen: Praise each other more, and avoid comparing who contributes more.

Thực Thần.y: You want a comfortable home with good food and happy conversation, and you like to spoil the person you love.
Thực Thần.loi_khuyen: Keep some time for yourself so you do not run dry from pleasing others.

Thương Quan.y: You expect a lot from your partner and can be critical when disappointed.
Thương Quan.loi_khuyen: Say what you need instead of what your partner did wrong.

Thiên Tài.tieu_de: Generous, likes to surprise your partner
Thiên Tài.y: You are generous and like to surprise your partner; the relationship has plenty of joy.
Thiên Tài.loi_khuyen: Keep the everyday steadiness alongside the surprises.

Chính Tài.y: You are faithful, value stability, and take care of your life together.
Chính Tài.loi_khuyen: Try something new together now and then so things do not go flat.

Thất Sát.tieu_de: Lots of love, lots of friction
Thất Sát.y: Your relationships carry strong emotions: a lot of love and a lot of friction.
Thất Sát.loi_khuyen: Learn to argue without insults, and make up the same day.
